name: create-rate-limit
prompt: A runaway client can hammer POST /session with the same id. Add per-id rate limiting in main.go: implement func allowCreate(id string, now time.Time) bool backed by a package-level map guarded by a mutex that records the last ACCEPTED create time per id; a POST for an id that was accepted less than 1 second ago must be refused with 429 Too Many Requests and must not touch the store. Allowed requests proceed exactly as before. The limiter must be safe for concurrent use and must not rate-limit different ids independently of each other (each id has its own window).
